change_scope: Edge Function parity evidence and a capability-preserving rollback procedure. Documentation and evidence only; no runtime, application, database, or provider state is modified.

review_remediation.finding: the rollback document named d0e689556cc01428500b796cade87032ea5c0ad8 as the full-capability target, but canonical main has advanced to aa228d5bfb59c0e54ed85415d6faaea3340f6c56
review_remediation.consequence: rolling to the documented SHA would silently discard everything merged after it, so it no longer proves capability-preserving rollback
review_remediation.fix: the release candidate is now defined as whatever commit canonical main points at when the rollback is performed, resolved from the repository at rollback time; the recorded SHA is explicitly labelled an observation rather than a target
review_remediation.recurrence_prevention: the procedure states that a rollback target read from a document is stale by construction and instructs the operator to resolve it from origin/main, so this cannot silently rot again
review_remediation.parity_manifest_updated: canonical_commit refreshed to current main with a note to recompute if main advances

edge_parity.method: read-only list_edge_functions and get_edge_function; no function deployed, updated, or invoked

rollback.release_candidate: current canonical main, resolved at rollback time
structural_gaps: Edge Functions version independently at Supabase and do not roll back with Vercel
no applied migration has rollback metadata at the provider, so there is no down-migration path for any of the 68

remaining_gates: independent review of this exact candidate head
fetch and byte-compare live source for pandora-machine-gateway and pandora-projectos-bridge
preview deployment plus route probes to close the web-tier rehearsal gate
separate authorization for any production promotion; rollback remains unproven until a safe rehearsal completes
